entities.summary: Zach Hankins is an American professional basketball player for Maccabi Tel Aviv of the Ligat HaAl and EuroLeague. He played college basketball for the Xavier Musketeers his senior season. As a power forward/center, Hankins was named the NCAA Division II National Player of the Year for the 2017–18 season while playing for Ferris State.
